form.title: Somatic Variant Calling for Long Reads (LRsomatic dev, test)
form.description: TEST of the lrsomatic dev branch: tumor/normal long-read (ONT) analysis with ecDNA/BFB detection and haplotype methylation

genome.title: Reference Genome
genome.description: Reference genome (iGenomes). Only GRCh38 is currently supported.

skip_options.title: Skip Options
skip_options.description: Tick a box to skip the corresponding analysis step.

skip_ascat.title: Skip ASCAT
skip_ascat.description: Skip ASCAT copy-number and purity/ploidy estimation.

skip_vep.title: Skip VEP
skip_vep.description: Skip variant annotation with Ensembl VEP.

skip_normalfiber.title: Skip Fiber-seq on normal samples
skip_normalfiber.description: Skip fibertools analysis of normal samples.

vep_cache_version.title: VEP cache version
vep_cache_version.description: Version of the VEP cache to use. Must be a GRCh38 version available in the public annotation-cache bucket.

skip_signatures.title: Skip mutational signatures
skip_signatures.description: Skip mutational signature analysis (SigProfilerMatrixGenerator and SigProfilerAssignment). Leave unticked to run it.

skip_coral.title: Skip CoRAL and AmpliconClassifier
skip_coral.description: Skip ecDNA amplicon reconstruction (CoRAL) and its classification. CoRAL needs ASCAT, so do not tick Skip ASCAT without ticking this.

skip_ampliconclassifier.title: Skip AmpliconClassifier only
skip_ampliconclassifier.description: Run CoRAL but skip the classifier, which is the step that calls ecDNA and BFB (BFBArchitect runs inside it). The classifier downloads the AmpliconArchitect GRCh38 data repository during the run.

modkit_phased.title: Phased methylation pileup
modkit_phased.description: Run modkit on the haplotagged BAMs and write haplotype 1, haplotype 2 and combined bedMethyl files. Needed for DMR calling.

skip_dmr.title: Skip DMR calling
skip_dmr.description: Skip haplotype differential methylation region calling. Only has an effect when Phased methylation pileup is ticked.

extra_params_json.title: Extra Parameters (JSON)
extra_params_json.description: Optional: provide additional workflow parameters as a JSON object (e.g. {"skip_dmr": true}). These override the form values, except input, outdir, igenomes_base, vep_cache, sigprofiler_genome_dir, vep_revel, vep_revel_tbi, monochrome_logs, custom_config_base, custom_config_version, validate_params, igenomes_ignore, genome (use the Reference Genome field), download_vep_cache and download_sigprofiler_genome, which are rejected. Maximum 10000 characters.
